title: ClientCommand
description: Commands accepted by the headless engine from any client.

binding.description:
Required when the pending approval displayed a unified diff. The
actor rejects missing or stale bindings without consuming the ask.

provider.description:
When set, route only through this configured provider for the
selected alias instead of using the alias's automatic fallback chain.

operation_id.description: Stable client-generated identity retained until the correlated fork completes.

CommandMeta.description: Metadata common to commands from all client transports.

ClientId.description: Stable identifier of a connected client.

RequestId.description: Client-generated identifier used to correlate a command.

SessionId.description: Stable identifier of an engine session.

TranscriptView.description: Exact canonical prefix interpreted by a complete semantic view.

TranscriptGeneration.description: Current semantic ordering generation, changed by rewind.

SequenceId.description: Monotonic per-session sequence encoded as a decimal string on the wire.

TranscriptItemId.description: Stable item identity, independent of its current logical ordinal.

TranscriptOrdinal.description: Logical row position, distinct from a canonical event sequence.

TranscriptContentSource.description: Body location within the exact journal prefix carried by its enclosing view.

TranscriptContentSelector.description: A closed selector into one canonical event. It never names a filesystem path.

ToolInvocationId.description: Host-owned identity of one tool execution, independent of provider call IDs.

ModelAlias.description: Provider-blind model alias resolved by the engine router.

ClientRole.description: Whether a client mutates the session or only observes it.

Attachment.description: User-provided content attached to a message.

source_path.description:
Optional normalized workspace-relative source path. Local absolute paths
never cross the client protocol; their in-band content may still be
attached under a safe basename.

AttachmentData.description: In-band attachment data; protocol messages never require shared files.

ToolCallId.description: Stable identifier assigned to a model tool call.

ApprovalDecision.description: A driver's decision at the permission chokepoint.

ApprovalBinding.description: Optional structured unified diff attached to a mutating-tool approval.

PlanDecision.description: Driver response to a submitted plan.

QuestionId.description: Stable identifier of an interactive question.

Answer.description: One answer returned for a question entry.

ModeId.description: Open identifier of a built-in or extension-provided mode.

TurnId.description: Stable identifier of a conversation turn.

RewindTarget.description: Rewind destination selected by a client.

RewindSourcePosition.description: Completed boundary relative to an effective committed user source.

ShellId.description: Engine-generated identifier of one foreground user shell.

ContextItemId.description: Stable identifier of one assembled context item.

ReviewFileDecision.description: Driver decision for one file in the cumulative session review.

McpEnvironmentEntry.description:
One explicit environment entry for a stdio MCP server.

The value is carried on the authenticated command wire but never exposed by
debug formatting.

PermissionDecision.description: Default permission decision used when no rule matches.

oneOf.description: Ask the active driver for approval.

TranscriptFormat.description: Stable transcript formats shared by CLI and authenticated clients.

PermissionApprovalScope.description: Scope of a remembered exact approval.

ProviderAuthAttemptId.description: Connection-scoped identifier of one provider authentication attempt.

SubagentId.description: Stable identifier of a child agent session.
